entities.name: Terisian Isles
entities.description: An archipelago of large and small islands, what remains of the former continent of Terisiare after the Flooding.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The former continent that was broken into islands by the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: The flooding that formed the Terisian archipelago.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: One of the most ancient kingdoms, the only country that did not collapse after the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: The capital of Almaaz, rebuilt almost 1300 years after its fall in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Gulmany
entities.description: A region of city-states and barrens including Baszerat, Morvern and Kovria.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: A region with Argivia as capital and sites such as the Karplusan Mountains and Korlis.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest of magnigoths home to Civimore and Rith's Grove.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: A ruined expanse of barren, lifeless rock in the Shattered Isles.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: A region home to the Duler Sanctum and the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Half-submerged ruins older than the forest in Yavimaya.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: The dweller of Rith's Grove in Yavimaya.

entities.name: Samisar
entities.description: An infamously viceful man from Evean.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A figure who made a home with Xantcha on the Ohran Ridge for a time.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A companion of Urza who made a home on the Ohran Ridge.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: A beast bound on Sarraza and released in 3050 AR, destroying the Chimes.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The blast that formed a rift cracking the Mori Tumulus.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war after which Almaaz alone remained intact.

events.summary: The Flooding of Terisiare breaks the continent into the Terisian archipelago.
events.quote: They are an archipelago of large and small islands formed after the Flooding of Terisiare .

events.summary: Almaaz is the only country that did not collapse in the wake of the Brothers' War.
events.quote: The only country that didn't collapse in the wake of the War.

events.summary: The Chimes, home of the Sarrazan elves, is destroyed in 3050 AR when the Beast of the Hours is released.
events.quote: Destroyed in 3050 AR upon the release of the Beast of the Hours .

events.summary: After the Fall of Sumifa in the Brothers' War, a new city of the same name is built almost 1300 years later.
events.quote: a new city of the same name was built after almost 1300 years.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast cracks the Mori Tumulus with a rift.
events.quote: a 500 foot tall, 300 mile long ridge cracked by a rift formed by the Sylex Blast

relations.quote: One of the most ancient kingdoms during the time of the Brothers.
